pages.title: Compacting
pages.text:
**Compacting** is a Mechanical Press working over a Basin. It runs any filled 2x2 or 3x3 crafting recipe, plus extra recipes, and some need heat from a burner below.\
\
Examples in this pack: a Cactus into purified water and green dye, chocolate into bars, and Yellowcake. JEI lists them.
